=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:410-413 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The drain loop stops at the first clean poll (`[ "${still_active}" -eq 0 ] && break`), so the orchestrator can dispatch new release-workflow runs between the final poll and the hold re-write (line 420) or the tag push (lines 485-502).
  WHY: A promote cycle that starts in that window can publish a release, clear the hold and re-release the regression, which defeats the rollback; severity is source MAJOR, shown as high (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash treat this as an accepted, documented residual and did not re-flag it).
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:301-305 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When a hold exists for the current stable version but cannot be read (e.g., `hold_read_error`), the explicit current-version target check refuses the rollback with `reason=hold_unknown`.
  WHY: The operator is told the hold is unknown and the rollback is refused even though the target is the current version (a re-run case), so read failures should be handled more clearly; severity is source NIT, shown as low (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considers this intended fail-closed behaviour, covered by `test_explicit_current_version_with_unreadable_hold_is_hold_unknown`).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "After a rollback, neither `auto-release-stable.yml` nor the `promote-main-to-stable.yml` cycle releases until a release is cut deliberately. The release job clears the hold when it publishes." (linked issue #9342, Summary/Goals)
  expected_change_site: the poller-dispatched `promote` job in `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` (job handling `target_sha`) and its dispatch path in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The promote job in .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml (job at line 155, target_sha handling at lines 211-258) never reads the hold and has no stable_hold reference, the poller can dispatch it with target_sha from scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh without checking the hold, the PR gates only the scheduled `cycle` job (hold read in `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1595-1610`) and drains active runs (`scripts/rollback_stable.sh:388-421`), and neither file is touched by the PR, so a promote run dispatched after the drain can fast-forward `stable`, release and clear the hold while the hold is active (severity MAJOR from both reviewers; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes the gap was deferred in eight prior editor rounds as outside the `files_touched` grant, is documented in `README.md:5130-5140` and `agents.d/9342-stable-rollback.md:5`, and was ruled a follow-up by the review judge; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 did not re-raise it for the same reasons)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
